opportunities.value_basis: Estimated annual value stated in the bid packet
opportunities.description: The City seeks a contractor for nightly janitorial services at three branch libraries (about 62,000 square feet in total): restroom cleaning, trash removal, dusting, floor care, and quarterly strip and wax. opportunities.title: Pressure Washing of Parking Garages and Plazas (sample)
opportunities.description: Quarterly pressure washing of four county parking garages and two downtown plazas, with water reclamation to meet storm water rules. One-year term with renewals. Subcontractors require prior written approval of the County before starting work. Contractor shall carry general liability of $1,000,000 and automobile liability of $1,000,000. Work is performed overnight between 10 p.m. and 5 a.m. to avoid garage traffic, with cones and signage placed by the contractor. Oil stains and gum are pre-treated before washing. The contractor must capture wash water and dispose of it at an approved facility, and submit a disposal log with each invoice. The County's facilities manager inspects each garage after service; areas that fail inspection are re-washed at no charge within five days.

opportunities.title: Post-Construction Cleaning, Records Building Renovation (sample)
opportunities.description: Rough clean and final clean of three renovated floors in the Records Building after construction: dust removal, window and glass cleaning, floor scrubbing, and debris haul-off. opportunities.title: Tree Trimming, Removal, and Stump Grinding in City Parks (sample)
opportunities.description: As-needed tree trimming, hazardous tree removal, and stump grinding across city parks. Work must be supervised by an ISA Certified Arborist. The contractor shall furnish all equipment, labor, and traffic control. Bidders must list any subcontractors they intend to use. General liability insurance of $2,000,000 is required. Work orders are issued by the Park & Recreation Department with a 10 business day completion window, or 24 hours for storm-damaged trees blocking trails. The contractor removes and disposes of all brush and wood, grinds stumps 8 inches below grade, and backfills with topsoil. Pricing is by tree diameter class and per stump. The City may add parks during the term at the same unit prices.
